text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out in the city with Calstone Light O,
we were handed an advertisement by a flyer distributor.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Refresh yourself in the great outdoors♪ Camping gear available for rent!"
...I see, camping.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For someone who trains hard every day,
this might be a nice change of pace.
choice_data_list: Shall we try enjoying a day camp?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good.
Let us make for the campsite together, then.
In a straight line, naturally.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Arriving at the campsite, we completed the
reservation for the barbecue at the reception desk.
Afterwards, as we explored the area—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
My, look at all these fish.
This looks like it'll be fun to play with.
choice_data_list: Looks like they rent out fishing rods over there.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No, I am fine.
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splash splash splash splash!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Here I goâHmph!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, it got away!
Splendid fins, but don't underestimate my speed!
Haaaaaaah!!
choice_data_list: With your bare hands, of all things!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's faster to go catch it
than to wait around slowly.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Trainer, join me.
Let's aim for a massive catch!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, the fish Trainer missed is heading this way—
Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, caught you!
That was great teamwork just now!
choice_data_list: Just like that, I'll lure the fish over to your side!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I see! Leave it to me, I'll catch 'em, catch 'em, and catch 'em all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We decided to barbecue the fish we caught for dinner.
Placing the ingredients in the center of the grill
so they would cook thoroughly...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
How naive. The grill is full of gaps.
Let me rearrange them a bit.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: You line up the ingredients in a straight row like this! Look, there are no gaps left. Packed tight!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, that meat right there looks just right.
Well then, down the hatch.
choice_data_list: Then, I'll put more meat on the empty spots.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hm!
Leave no gaps, grill them immediately――

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Splendid! Just like that. Now, let's grill and eat as much as we can.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, a miscalculation.
I didn't expect onions to burn this easily...!
I must eat this quickly and grill more!
choice_data_list: Y-Yeah! ...Ow, hot!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
This is nothing!
If I chew as fast as possible before I feel the heat—
*munch* *nom nom nom* IT'S SO HOOOOTTT!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Making the most of our limited time to enjoy ourselves to the fullest.
It was a camping trip full of initiative and energy.
choice_data_list: (Somehow, that's just so like Light O.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, by the time we had finished the barbecue,
it was nearly time to head home.
We decided to enjoy a bonfire to wrap up the day.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it's flickering wildly.
It's burning quite fiercely, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Let's burn more and more, then.
Where are the straight branches?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I handed her a certain item
I had just bought from the campsite store.
choice_data_list: If you'd like, how about this one too?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Are these... fireworks?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Making the most of her time to play to her heart's content.
Because she was that kind of girl,
I felt it was truly fitting for her.
choice_data_list: I figured if it were you, you'd want to enjoy both.
I figured you'd want to enjoy both.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I see! Let's do it. With two beauties together, it's bound to be the best.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Look at these fireworks!
Straight as an arrow, and so colorful!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Most of all, it burned out in the blink of an eye!
That speed is truly admirable!"
choice_data_list: I thought you'd say that, so I prepared plenty!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, as expected of you, Trainer!
To think you understand me so well!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: We're practically of one mind and body now! Our hearts are totally in sync, aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a magnificent sparkle.
It's so lovely, I could gaze at it forever.
choice_data_list: Maybe we could try a different kind of fireworks next time.
Thanks to you, I was able to witness a special sight.
I got to see a truly special sight thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a magnificent sparkle.
It's so lovely, I could gaze at it forever.
choice_data_list: Maybe we could try a different kind of fireworks next time.
Thanks to you, I was able to witness a special sight.
I got to see a truly special sight thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, bottle rockets would be best next.
Streaking in a straight line, blazing at ferocious speed.
Those are truly magnificent."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
And let's make the bonfire even bigger.
Next time, let's make it a full campfire.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I can't just stand here. I must find a place where both can be enjoyed.
choice_data_list: I'll help you search too.
I'll help you look for it too!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please.
Let's go see that brilliant radiance together again.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Mmh... Thanks to me, you say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking action and enjoying your days off to the fullest.
If you hadn't taught me that way of spending time,
I'm sure I never would have realized it.
choice_data_list: That brilliance was something I could only see because I was with you.
It's a brilliance we could only see because we're together.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. Something that could only be seen
because the two of you were together...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear that. Yippee.
...In that case, let us continue to gaze upon the same sights together.
